card.name: Ending of KYBELLA and names like Bella
card.fires_on: The final piece of a name or brand: the "LA" that completes KYBELLA in drug-label text, and the "bella/Bella" or "ell" ending of personal names and rare words like Anteb-ellum.

modes.example: Do not dilute or mix KYBEL<<LA>> with other compounds.

modes.description: The "bella" or "Bella" piece of a first name in lists of people or news quotes.
